text: The Nominating Panel - Property Standards will conduct interviews and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment to the Property Standards Committee.

The Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the Roberta Jennings to the Property Standards Committee, for a term of office ending May 5, 2025, and until a successor is appointed. 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 4 to the report (June 14, 2022) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Property Standards Committee.
